assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package is a formal AI submission for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Official SITE_BOUNDARY and KEY_AREA polygons are not yet public; provisional_boundaries.geojson is used and every geometry is marked provisional_constraint.
assumptions.impact: All area-sensitive metrics (site, green, public, key areas) must be recalculated in EPSG:4548 when official geometry is supplied; design judgments remain valid.

assumptions.statement: Service desks, windows, scenario cards, event system and operators are concept proposals for professional deepening, not settled government arrangements.
assumptions.impact: Reviewers should treat all service/operation content as design direction; no implementation commitment is implied.

assumptions.statement: Building footprints are concept design quantities derived from this package's geometry, not existing-building surveys, statutory floor area or demolition conclusions.
assumptions.impact: Building-related metrics are indicative only; official surveys and regulatory conditions are required before any statutory use.
